quote: Very beautiful home, by the way, Raymond.
stewart_read: Personalized, specific compliment (not generic) that visibly warms the customer's later responses.
coaching_implication: Keep this move — specific, non-generic personalization is a repeatable rapport builder for this rep.

quote: some people get them for free. I don't believe that. And then some people are alone. Like, it's it's really, really expensive.
stewart_read: Customer hands the rep a cost-confusion objection that is a textbook trigger for the bill-swap flip.
alternative_hypothesis: Reactive: rep didn't recognize this as an objection moment and treated it as a factual question about competitors.
coaching_implication: Should have gone straight to 'what's expensive is staying on ComEd's bill' before hedging about competitor programs.

quote: So it really just depends. I mean, different companies have, you know, different programs. So I'm really not sure, you know, what kind of deals they got
stewart_read: Rep openly admits uncertainty about competitor pricing structures rather than redirecting immediately to the specialist.
alternative_hypothesis: Strategic read considered: rep may be buying time to formulate the bill-swap line — but the hedging itself adds no value and could have been skipped straight to the flip.
coaching_implication: Use the escape hatch immediately: 'that's exactly what our specialist breaks down' instead of guessing at competitor programs.

quote: our program here, all it is is a bill swap. All we'll be doing is, replacing your electric bill with, ComEd and, swapping that out for a cheaper solar payment.
stewart_read: Rep recovers and links back to the earlier captured bill amount, framing it as replaceable — this is the flip, though soft.
coaching_implication: This is close to the objection_inversion flip; sharpening it with the customer's actual $150 number would land harder.

quote: I think it's, like, about 50 a month.
stewart_read: Customer gives a bill figure (later clarified/misheard as $150) and rep immediately moves to the next verify item without reflecting the number back as a hook.
coaching_implication: Should reflect the number back — 'so you're paying $150/month to ComEd, that's exactly what we can target' — before moving on.

quote: My daughter's a a bowler, and she's in a couple of days. So I'm her chauffeur on, Saturday.
stewart_read: Minor personal detail volunteered showing continued rapport and comfort, not a qualification signal but indicative of an engaged, relaxed customer.
coaching_implication: Rep handled fine by working around the schedule constraint; no action needed beyond noting comfort level.

quote: get with your wife and see if you can just, take a picture of of, your bill and send it over, then I can get you guys on the on the schedule here
stewart_read: The appointment time is set but explicitly conditioned on the bill photo being sent later — a fragile, deferred-dependency booking.
coaching_implication: Flag as conditional in handoff; closer should confirm bill was received before treating this as a firm sit.
